canonical_name: No Compliance Review with Security Policies
description: Compliance with security policies and standards is not regularly reviewed.
applicability: Applies when an organization does not regularly review compliance with its information security policies, topic-specific policies, rules, and standards, or fails to take corrective action when non-compliance is identified.

metadata.detection_notes: Review compliance monitoring procedures, verify policy compliance assessment schedules, check for compliance metrics and reporting, assess non-compliance issue tracking and resolution, examine management review of compliance status.
